faq.q: What is an AI how-to video template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made demonstration scene. Add one product photo and generate a clip that shows one useful task from setup to result.

faq.q: Do I need to write prompts to use these templates?
faq.a: No. Pick a task style, upload your product photo and generate. Step two can include one short line about the action if you want.

faq.q: Who are how-to templates built for?
faq.a: Product sellers, support teams and agencies that need a clear demonstration for listings, Shorts, Reels or ads.

faq.q: Can one video show several steps in a row?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the clip focused on one task and let the sequence show its main actions in order.

faq.q: Will the video include spoken instructions?
faq.a: The template creates the visual clip. Add narration, captions or step labels in your editor after download.

faq.q: What product photo works best for a how-to video?
faq.a: Use a clear photo of the whole product with its working part visible and no important edge cropped.

faq.q: How many steps fit in one tutorial?
faq.a: A short clip works best with one task and a few readable actions. Add longer written instructions outside the generated frame.

faq.q: How fast is a how-to video made?
faq.a: A clip is generated in minutes after you start the job, with no presenter, studio day or reshoot.

faq.q: What does a how-to video cost?
faq.a: A 6-, 10-, 15- or 30-second clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits, shown before you run it.

faq.q: Can I use a how-to video in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for instructions and claims.
